title: A service card: creation, types and reuse
goal: Save and reread a service, inspect its metadata types and reuse the same item in separate requests.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: Two requests use one service but take different times. Where does its description belong, and where do the minutes of a particular contact belong? Follow reuse of one card and verify it after renaming. Today’s rate and the price of an earlier contact also require different data.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The previous ReportsV 2 fixture stores request headers but has neither Работы nor a custom explicit form. In a prepared separate copy add the table and form only through the lesson steps below. Preserve the A 4 customer note and old documents. The example and new work use different own sets; do not substitute a whole-database total for two particular numbers. Nexus stores the explanation and note; perform the actions in installed1C.

sections.title: Code differs from name
paragraphs: A code supports agreed lookup/exchange rules; a name serves people; a reference supplies internal identity. Services can have similar names, so check code and meaning before adding one. Do not create a duplicate merely because a text search missed a row hidden by a filter.

Inspect Услуги in Designer, including standard Код/Наименование and any custom attributes, then open the actual service card in Enterprise. Metadata defines available fields; the card contains one item’s values. Use actual field names and types rather than placing a price in the name to imitate a missing attribute.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Inspect properties, Data and standard attributes. Record Код/Наименование names/types and two custom fields if present. Rename nothing. Expected: A field/type/purpose table is recorded.
Step 2. Enter Диагностика A5 — выезд. Save, close and reopen by its actual code. Reuse your existing attempt if present. Expected: The same code opens again.
Step 3. Create own requests with an existing synthetic customer, this service, Новая and 20/40 minutes. Record numbers. Expected: Two requests reuse one service.
Step 4. Append — проверено, save and reopen both requests. Open the service from each and compare the code; durations stay 20/40. Expected: Same service code and original durations.

Step 5. Record actual codes/numbers, field types and the conclusion: reuse works, dated pricing is not implemented. Preserve your work with the normal backup route. Expected: Another reader can verify the specific records.

sections.title: Rates can change over time
paragraphs: A current rate in a card suffices for the initial model but does not describe price history. If an old request must preserve the agreed cost, store its applied rate in the document. P6 introduces periodic prices. Do not silently recalculate old documents from today’s card without a separate business rule.

Create Диагностика A5 — выезд and record its code. Select it in two own requests of 20 and 40 minutes. Creating another request must not require another service item. After renaming the service, both links should still open the same code. A customer code and a service code belong to different catalogs.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: The service name changes from 500 to 600. Has the old request gained a rate history?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. A card caption changed, not the model of a rate at a date. Verify reuse through its service code and reference. History requires separately stored values and rules; this lesson does not introduce them.

sections.title: Duplicates need a criterion
paragraphs: The teaching set uses unique service codes. Repeating the seed must find existing items rather than insert duplicates. A name lookup alone is not a uniqueness policy. Stop and explain ambiguous matches. Automatically deleting one similar-looking item can destroy document references.

A service name or description does not establish its price on a request date. Historical tariffs need a separate model, such as the periodic register introduced in the programming course. This exercise covers catalog reuse, not currency, payroll or statutory accounting.

paragraphs: Use the second worked case only in an own copy or unsaved draft. Preserve the accepted record and explain the discrepancy.
Keep minutes in the document and select a reusable service card.

sections.title: Verify repeatability
paragraphs: Create Consultation andSetup with codesS1, S2, then repeat the same-code input. Compare counts and references, not only labels. RenameS1 in a copy and reopen a linked request. Keep source and test copy distinct so rate experiments do not alter earlier work.

Specify the minimal scenario before changing metadata. An optional text description can follow module 4 in a separate copy: define its type/length, add the attribute and check older items. Changing an existing populated field’s type needs data analysis and recovery planning. The core exercise inspects existing types and saves your own service.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In your copy create a new fictional service “Учебная проверка A 5” and two requests of 15 and 35 minutes using it. Use one existing training customer. Record actual request numbers and service code, then append “— проверено” to this service’s name. Follow its link from each reopened request and compare the code. Reuse your existing attempt rather than duplicating services; preserve earlier cards.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: Two newly restored copies in actual1C verify references after renaming, row persistence, absence of automatic recalculation, empty-header refusal, the actual named form and fresh reads. Main 9/255 and independent 9/290 include earlier 4/120. All old fields and the A 4 note persist. Two GUI captures show only their labelled forms. Manual wizard, full Tab, permissions, installer, devices and learner understanding are NOT RUN.
